text: No occupancy figure was reported for 19 Nov; the last reported figure is 93 of 183 rooms (50.8%) on 16 Nov, 44 of them Rabdan. Operations collected the occupied and vacant room list: Security could not access some vacant rooms and found some IDs missing for occupied rooms, with follow-up on 20 Nov. Operations again said the rent increase is affecting occupancy and renewals.
Reports for 19 Nov received from Operations, Maintenance (with work photos), IT and the Flower shop. HR & Accounts, Housekeeping and AJ1881 reports were not seen.

Operations sent the ADNOC approval email for the 50 premium-room offer and is waiting for ADNOC’s response; Risk Management and the Emergency Response Plan are still listed for completion. The Ras Al Khaimah client’s approved proposal (15 premium rooms, 5 days) is waiting for the client’s confirmation.

An observation report received 19 Nov listed guest concerns: the room 212 tenant objects to the renewal rate increase, one guest is concerned about emergency exits, a vehicle often blocks the main entrance, the pool has no lifeguard or chairs, plants obstruct the reception area, and the spa raised a privacy concern about ID checks at the basement parking. Operations also reported one tenant incident on the night of 18 Nov, handled with Civil Defence.

Maintenance completed 10 jobs on 19 Nov, including lamps in rooms 501 and 503, basement 1–4 lights, ceiling and plastering work and a missing AC diffuser. Still pending: the basement lift lobby painting, room 706 thermostat, basement parking lights, room 710 FCU rewinding (awaiting approval), the rooftop calorifier leak and a Tamouh site inspection. IT fixed 2 complaints (control room CCTV monitor, room 1507 Wi-Fi), prepared rooms 304 and 310 and installed a CCTV camera in the service lift.

The flower shop recorded no sales, contacted bloggers about collaborations and asked a supplier for a chiller van quotation. Operations asked PAL Group on 20 Nov what works and permits the Blumont Café outdoor setup needs; the Al Khayam quotation for the café, kiosk and buffet is still pending.

Operations met the facility management company about the building management system and emailed them about the general maintenance inspection. Interviews were held for Accounts, Receptionist and Florist positions. The Etisalat portal was down; IT is to follow up on 20 Nov.

Awaiting decision: elevator AMC renewal, the facility management AMC proposal (BMS, lift, Tamouh), room 710 FCU rewinding, the Etisalat connection option and bill, the lobby partition concern, the MBG accounting and VAT proposal, the AJ1881 rename and kitchen purchase, and pending offer letters and visa processing.
